events.label: The Door Opens Beneath Heaven
events.description: The Tavern door opens onto a white-metal platform inside a tower so tall its upper structure disappears into radiant haze. Ancient machines repeat an Ascension protocol whose candidate never left.

events.label: First Consecrated Lift
events.description: A motionless lift bears four old sigils: sanctification, preservation, crucible, and cognition. Only the sanctification circuit still answers immediately.

events.label: First Halo Patrol
events.description: Holy guardian machines pivot toward the unregistered expedition and invoke the protocol to protect the final Ascension candidate.
